461:       if (g_ack_slots[i].state == ACK_SLOT_FREE)
462:         {
463:           g_ack_slots[i].state = ACK_SLOT_QUEUED;
464:           return &g_ack_slots[i];
465:         }
466:     }
467: 
468:   g_stats.ack_overflow++;
469:   return NULL;
470: }
471: 
472: static int dispatch_locked(void)
473: {
474:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = current_recovery();
475:   struct active_transaction *active;
476:   struct logical_channel *channel;
477:   unsigned int i;
478:   int ret;
479: 
480:   /* ACKs always outrank RESET and ordinary commands. */
481: 
482:   for (i = 0; i < MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
483:     {
484:       if (g_ack_slots[i].state != ACK_SLOT_QUEUED)
485:         {
486:           continue;
487:         }
488: 
489:       ret = send_slot(&g_ack_slots[i].message, &g_ack_slots[i].order);
490:       if (ret < 0)
491:         {
492:           return ret;
493:         }
494: 
495:       g_ack_slots[i].state = ACK_SLOT_SENT;
496:     }
497: 
498:   if (g_reset_pending)
499:     {
500:       ret = send_slot(&epoch->reset, &epoch->reset_order);
501:       if (ret < 0)
502:         {
503:           return ret;
504:         }
505: 
506:       g_reset_pending = false;
507:       epoch->reset_sent = true;
508:       set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING);
509:     }
510: 
511:   if (g_active.busy || busy_probe() != NULL)
512:     {
513:       return OK;
514:     }
515: 
516:   for (i = 0; i < MB_CHANNEL_COUNT; i++)
517:     {
518:       channel = &g_channels[i];
519:       if (!channel->queued)
520:         {
521:           continue;
522:         }
523: 
524:       if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING)
525:         {
526:           if (g_channel_ids[i] == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
527:               bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending) ==
528:               BK7258_MB_UART_STATE)
529:             {
530:               active = &epoch->probe;
531:             }
532:           else
533:             {
534:               continue;
535:             }
536: 
537:           if (active == &epoch->probe && active->quarantine &&
538:               !epoch->replay)
539:             {
540:               return -ENOLINK;
541:             }
542:         }
543:       else if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY)
544:         {
545:           active = &g_active;
546:           if (active->quarantine)
547:             {
548:               return -ENOLINK;
549:             }
550:         }
551:       else
552:         {
553:           return OK;
554:         }
555: 
556:       if (!epoch->replay || active != &epoch->probe)
557:         {
558:           memset(&active->message, 0, sizeof(active->message));
559:           memcpy(&active->message, &channel->pending,
560:                  sizeof(active->message));
561:           active->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
562:             bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending),
563:             bk7258_mb_header_state(&channel->pending), 0, ++g_tx_seq,
564:             g_channel_ids[i]);
565:         }
566: 
567:       active->callback = channel->callback;
568:       active->arg = channel->arg;
569:       active->channel_index = i;
570:       active->started = clock_systime_ticks();
571:       active->busy = true;
572:       ret = send_slot(&active->message, &active->order);
573:       if (ret < 0)
574:         {
575:           active->busy = false;
576:           return ret;
577:         }
578: 
579:       if (active == &epoch->probe)
580:         {
581:           if (epoch->first_probe_order == 0)
582:             {
583:               epoch->first_probe_order = active->order;
584:             }
585: 
586:           g_probe_attempts++;
587:           g_stats.probes++;
588:         }
589: 
590:       return OK;
591:     }
592: 
593:   return OK;
594: }

596: static uint32_t ack_header_reason(
597:   const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
598:   const struct active_transaction *active)
599: {
600:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
601:   uint32_t reason = 0;
602: 
603:   if (!active->busy)
604:     {
605:       return 1u;
606:     }
607: 
608:   if (control != BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX)
609:     {
610:       reason |= 2u;
611:     }
612:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) !=
613:       bk7258_mb_header_channel(&active->message))
614:     {
615:       reason |= 4u;
616:     }
617:   if (bk7258_mb_header_seq(message) !=
618:       bk7258_mb_header_seq(&active->message))
619:     {
620:       reason |= 8u;
621:     }
622:   if (bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) !=
623:       bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&active->message))
624:     {
625:       reason |= 16u;
626:     }
627: 
628:   return reason;
629: }

631: static bool valid_uart_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
632: {
633:   return (message->payload_address & ~3u) == 0 &&
634:          message->payload_length == 0 && message->flags == 0 &&
635:          message->crc8 == 0 && message->reserved == 0;
636: }
637: 
638: static void handle_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
639: {
640:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = current_recovery();
641:   struct active_transaction *active;
642:   bool replay;
643:   int result;
644:   uint32_t reason;
645: 
646: 
647:   active = busy_probe();
648:   if (active == NULL)
649:     {
650:       active = &g_active;
651:     }
652: 
653:   g_stats.last_ack_header = message->header;
654:   g_stats.last_active_header = active->message.header;
655:   reason = ack_header_reason(message, active);
656:   if (reason != 0)
657:     {
658:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
659:       g_stats.bad_ack_reason |= reason;
660:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(0, g_stats.last_ack_header);
661:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(1, g_stats.last_active_header);
662:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(2, g_stats.bad_ack_reason);
663:       return;
664:     }
665: 
666: 
667:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
668:       !valid_uart_ack(message))
669:     {
670:       /* Keep active stable.  A malformed ACK is not an ownership proof. */
671: 
672:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
673:       g_stats.bad_ack_reason |= 32u;
674:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(2, g_stats.bad_ack_reason);
675:       return;
676:     }
677: 
678:   if ((bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & ~BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0)
679:     {
680:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
681:       g_stats.bad_ack_reason |= 64u;
682:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(2, g_stats.bad_ack_reason);
683:       return;
684:     }
685: 
686:   result = (bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0 ?
687:            -EREMOTEIO : OK;
688: 
689:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
690:       result == OK && (message->payload_address & 2u) != 0)
691:     {
692:       result = -EREMOTEIO;
693:     }
694: 
695:   replay = active == &epoch->probe && epoch->replay;
696:   release_acks_before(replay ? epoch->first_probe_order : active->order);
697:   if (replay)
698:     {
699:       unsigned int replay_index = g_recovery_index;
700:       unsigned int i;
701: 
702:       /* This ACK may be a late ACK for the original copy.  It proves every
703:        * older epoch was copied, but not that the new replay envelope was
704:        * copied.  Preserve the replay epoch, free only older epochs, and use
705:        * one of them for a fresh-sequence confirmation probe.
706:        */
707: 
708:       complete_transaction(active, message, -EAGAIN);
709:       g_active.quarantine = false;
710:       for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
711:         {
712:           if (i != replay_index)
713:             {
714:               memset(&g_recovery[i], 0, sizeof(g_recovery[i]));
715:             }
716:         }
717: 
718:       select_recovery_epoch();
719:       (void)dispatch_locked();
720:       return;
721:     }
722: 
723:   complete_transaction(active, message, result);
724: 
725:   if (active == &epoch->probe)
726:     {
727:       if (result == OK && (message->flags & 2u) == 0)
728:         {
729:           release_recovery_slots();
730:           g_recovery_index = 0;
731:           g_probe_attempts = 0;
732:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_READY);
733:         }
734:       else if (result == -EREMOTEIO &&
735:                g_probe_attempts < MB_PROBE_MAX_ATTEMPTS)
736:         {
737:           /* CP may not have opened MB_UART0 yet.  The matched ACK proves
738:            * that this probe slot is no longer referenced by its FIFO.
739:            */
740:         }
741:       else
742:         {
743:           g_stats.probe_fail++;
744:           epoch->probe.quarantine = result == -ETIMEDOUT;
745:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN);
746:         }
747:     }
748: 
749:   else if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
750:            result < 0)
751:     {
752:       begin_abort(result);
753:     }
754: 
755:   (void)dispatch_locked();
756: }
757: 
758: static int handle_command(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
759: {
760:   struct ack_slot *slot;
761:   unsigned int rx_index;
762:   uint8_t channel = bk7258_mb_header_channel(message);
763:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
764:   uint8_t ack_flags = 0;
765:   uint8_t state = 0;
766:   int ret = -ENOSYS;
767: 
768:   g_stats.last_command_header = message->header;
769: 
770:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) == 0)
771:     {
772:       slot = alloc_ack_slot();
773:       if (slot == NULL)
774:         {
775:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
776:           return -EAGAIN;
777:         }
778:     }
779:   else
780:     {
781:       slot = NULL;
782:     }
783: 
784:   if ((control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0 ||
785:       bk7258_mb_header_state(message) != 0 ||
786:       (channel & 0xf0u) != 0x40u)
787:     {
788:       g_stats.bad_header++;
789:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
790:     }
791:   else if ((rx_index = rx_channel_index(channel)) < MB_RX_CHANNEL_COUNT &&
792:            g_rx_callbacks[rx_index] != NULL)
793:     {
794:       ret = g_rx_callbacks[rx_index](message, &ack_flags,
795:                                       g_rx_args[rx_index]);
796:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
797:         {
798:           if (slot != NULL)
799:             {
800:               slot->state = ACK_SLOT_FREE;
801:             }
802: 
803:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
804:           return -EAGAIN;
805:         }
806:       else if (ret < 0)
807:         {
808:           state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
809:         }
810:     }
811:   else if (channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_PWC_RX && g_pwc_rx != NULL)
812:     {
813:       ret = g_pwc_rx(message);
814:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
815:         {
816:           if (slot != NULL)
817:             {
818:               slot->state = ACK_SLOT_FREE;
819:             }
820: 
821:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
822:           return -EAGAIN;
823:         }
824:       else if (ret < 0)
825:         {
826:           state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
827:         }
828:     }
829:   else if (channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_SARADC_RX &&
830:            (bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) == 0u ||
831:             bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) == 1u) &&
832:            message->payload_address == 1u &&
833:            message->payload_length == 0u && message->flags == 0u &&
834:            message->crc8 == 0u && message->reserved == 0u)
835:     {
836:       /* Match Armino's SARADC operation-notification ABI. */
837:       ack_flags = 2u;
838:       ret = OK;
839:     }
840:   else
841:     {
842:       g_stats.unsupported++;
843:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
844:     }
845: 
846:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) != 0)
847:     {
848:       return OK;
849:     }
850: 
851:   memset(&slot->message, 0, sizeof(slot->message));
852:   slot->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
853:     bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message), state, BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX,
854:     bk7258_mb_header_seq(message), channel);
855:   slot->message.payload_address = ack_flags;
856: 
857:   if (ack_slots_used() >= MB_ACK_HIGH_WATER)
858:     {
859:       g_probe_requested = true;
860:     }
861: 
862:   (void)dispatch_locked();
863:   return OK;
864: }
865: 
866: static int mailbox_rx(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
867: {
868:   irqstate_t flags;
869:   uint8_t control;
870: 
871:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
872:   g_stats.rx++;
873:   control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
874: 
875:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET) != 0)
876:     {
877:       if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX) == 0 ||
878:           (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) & 0xf0u) != 0x40u ||
879:           (control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0)
880:         {
881:           g_stats.bad_header++;
882:         }
883:       else
884:         {
885:           g_stats.resets++;
886:           g_peer_reset_generation++;
887:           bk7258_mbox_discard_deferred();
888:           begin_abort(-ECONNRESET);
889:         }
890:     }
891:   else if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX) != 0)
892:     {
893:       handle_ack(message);
894:     }
895:   else
896:     {
897:       int ret = handle_command(message);
898: 
899:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
900:         {
901:           rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
902:           return ret;
903:         }
904:     }
905: 
906:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
907:   nxsem_post(&g_tx_sem);
908:   return OK;
909: }

911: static int mailbox_diag_worker(int argc, char **argv)
912: {
913:   enum bk7258_mb_link_state reported = BK7258_MB_LINK_QUIESCING;
914:   int ret;
915: 
916:   (void)argc;
917:   (void)argv;
918:   ret = bind_worker_to_primary();
919:   if (ret < 0)
920:     {
921:       return -EXDEV;
922:     }
923: 
924:   for (;;)
925:     {
926:       nxsem_wait_uninterruptible(&g_diag_sem);
927:       irqstate_t flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
928:       enum bk7258_mb_link_state state = g_diag_state;
929:       bk7258_mb_link_callback_t callback = g_link_callback;
930:       void *callback_arg = g_link_arg;
931:       uint32_t timeout = g_stats.timeout;
932:       uint32_t bad_ack = g_stats.bad_ack;
933:       uint8_t epoch = g_recovery_index;
934: 
935:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
936:       if (reported == state)
937:         {
938:           continue;
939:         }
940: 
941:       reported = state;
942:       if (reported != BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING &&
943:           reported != BK7258_MB_LINK_READY)
944:         {
945:           syslog(LOG_WARNING,
946:                  "mailbox: link state=%u epoch=%u timeout=%lu bad_ack=%lu\n",
947:                  reported, epoch, (unsigned long)timeout,
948:                  (unsigned long)bad_ack);
949:         }
950: 
951:       if (callback != NULL)
952:         {
953:           callback(reported, callback_arg);
954:         }
955:     }
956: 
957:   return OK;
958: }

960: static int mailbox_tx_worker(int argc, char **argv)
961: {
962:   int ret;
963: 
964:   (void)argc;
965:   (void)argv;
966:   ret = bind_worker_to_primary();
967:   if (ret < 0)
968:     {
969:       ret = -EXDEV;
970:     }
971: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
972:   else if (!bk7258_smp_secondary_is_ready())
973:     {
974:       ret = -EAGAIN;
975:     }
976: #endif
977:   if (ret < 0)
978:     {
979:       return ret;
980:     }
981: 
982:   for (;;)
983:     {
984:       struct active_transaction *probe;
985:       irqstate_t flags;
986:       bool request_probe;
987: 
988:       (void)nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_tx_sem, MB_WORK_INTERVAL);
989:       flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
990: 
991:       probe = busy_probe();
992:       if ((g_active.busy &&
993:            clock_systime_ticks() - g_active.started >= MB_TIMEOUT) ||
994:           (probe != NULL &&
995:            clock_systime_ticks() - probe->started >= MB_TIMEOUT))
996:         {
997:           g_stats.timeout++;
998:           bk7258_boottrace_detail(3,
999:             (g_stats.last_tx_error & 0xffu) |
1000:             ((g_stats.timeout & 0xffu) << 8) |
1001:             ((g_stats.fifo_full & 0xffu) << 16) |
1002:             ((g_stats.ack_overflow & 0xffu) << 24));
1003:           if (probe != NULL)
1004:             {
1005:               probe->quarantine = true;
1006:               complete_transaction(probe, NULL, -ETIMEDOUT);
1007:               g_stats.probe_fail++;
1008:               set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN);
1009:             }
1010:           else
1011:             {
1012:               begin_abort(-ETIMEDOUT);
1013:             }
1014:         }
1015: 
1016:       if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN &&
1017:           clock_systime_ticks() - g_down_since >= MB_DOWN_RETRY)
1018:         {
1019:           select_recovery_epoch();
1020:         }
1021: 
1022:       (void)dispatch_locked();
1023:       if (g_probe_requested && ack_slots_used() < MB_ACK_HIGH_WATER)
1024:         {
1025:           g_probe_requested = false;
1026:         }
1027: 
1028:       request_probe = g_probe_requested &&
1029:                       g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY &&
1030:                       !g_channels[4].queued && !g_active.busy;
1031:       if (request_probe)
1032:         {
1033:           g_probe_requested = false;
1034:         }
1035: 
1036:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1037: 
1038:       if (request_probe)
1039:         {
1040:           bk7258_mb_uart_request_state();
1041:         }
1042:     }
1043: 
1044:   return OK;
1045: }

1075: int bk7258_mailbox_workers_start(void)
1076: {
1077:   cpu_set_t cpuset;
1078:   int ret;
1079: 
1080:   if (!g_initialized)
1081:     {
1082:       return -EAGAIN;
1083:     }
1084: 
1085:   if (g_workers_started)
1086:     {
1087:       return OK;
1088:     }
1089: 
1090:   ret = wait_secondary_scheduler();
1091:   if (ret < 0)
1092:     {
1093:       return ret;
1094:     }
1095: 
1096: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
1097:   /* All physical CP descriptors must originate on logical CPU0.  Pin the
1098:    * creator before activating the workers so their inherited affinity is
1099:    * CPU0-only from their first scheduled instruction. */
1100: 
1101:   CPU_ZERO(&cpuset);
1102:   CPU_SET(0, &cpuset);
1103:   ret = sched_setaffinity(0, sizeof(cpuset), &cpuset);
1104:   if (ret < 0)
1105:     {
1106:       return ret;
1107:     }
1108: #endif
1109: 
1110:   ret = bk7258_timer_start();
1111:   if (ret < 0)
1112:     {
1113:       return ret;
1114:     }
1115: 
1116:   bk7258_boottrace_primary(BK7258_BOOT_TIMER_RETURN);
1117: 
1118:   if (!g_tx_worker_created)
1119:     {
1120:       ret = kthread_create("mbox-v2", MB_TX_BOOT_PRIORITY, 2048,
1121:                            mailbox_tx_worker, NULL);
1122:       if (ret < 0)
1123:         {
1124:           return ret;
1125:         }
1126: 
1127:       g_tx_worker_created = true;
1128:       g_tx_worker_pid = ret;
1129:     }
1130:

244:   uintptr_t rdata1;
245:   uintptr_t sidreg;
246:   int cpu = up_cpu_index();
247:   unsigned int budget = MBOX_IRQ_DRAIN_BUDGET;
248: 
249:   (void)irq;
250:   (void)context;
251:   (void)arg;
252: 
253:   mbox_clear_errors(cpu);
254:   if (cpu == 1 && bk7258_boottrace_secondary_stage() >=
255:                   BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_ACK &&
256:                   bk7258_boottrace_secondary_stage() <
257:                   BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX_ENTER)
258:     {
259:       bk7258_boottrace_secondary(BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX_ENTER);
260:     }
261:   sidreg = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_SID : BK7258_MBOX_CH2_SID;
262:   rdata0 = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_RDATA0 : BK7258_MBOX_CH2_RDATA0;
263:   rdata1 = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_RDATA1 : BK7258_MBOX_CH2_RDATA1;
264: 
265:   while ((bk7258_mbox_rx_status() & 2u) == 0 && budget-- != 0)
266:     {
267:       struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc;
268:       uint32_t address;
269:       uint32_t length;
270:       uint8_t source;
271: 
272:       if (cpu == 0)
273:         {
274:           mbox_process_desc();
275:         }
276: 
277:       desc = cpu == 0 ? mbox_alloc_desc() : NULL;
278:       if (cpu == 0 && desc == NULL)
279:         {
280:           g_stats.descriptor_full++;
281:           mbox_trace_errors();
282:           break;
283:         }
284: 
285:       source = getreg32(sidreg) & 0x0fu;
286:       address = getreg32(rdata0);
287:       length = getreg32(rdata1);
288: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
289:       if (length == 0)
290:         {
291:           if (source == (uint8_t)(2 - cpu))
292:             {
293:               if (cpu == 1 && address == BK7258_MBOX_RAW_KICK)
294:                 {
295:                   bk7258_boottrace_secondary(BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX_RAW);
296:                 }
297: 
298:               bk7258_smp_ipi_receive(irq, context, address);
299:             }
300:           else
301:             {
302:               if (cpu == 0)
303:                 {
304:                   g_stats.bad_source++;
305:                   mbox_trace_errors();
306:                 }
307:             }
308: 
309:           continue;
310:         }
311: #endif
312: 
313:       if (cpu != 0)
314:         {
315:           continue;
316:         }
317: 
318:       if (!mbox_valid_envelope(source, address, length))
319:         {
320:           continue;
321:         }
322: 
323:       __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
324:       memcpy(&desc->message, (const void *)(uintptr_t)address,
325:              sizeof(desc->message));
326:       desc->order = ++g_rx_order;
327:       desc->used = true;
328:       g_stats.rx_messages++;
329:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(0, desc->message.header);
330:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(1, address);
331:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(2, g_stats.rx_messages);
332:       mbox_process_desc();
333:     }
334: 
335:   if (cpu == 0)
336:     {
337:       mbox_process_desc();
338:     }
339: 
340:   if (cpu == 1 && bk7258_boottrace_secondary_stage() ==
341:                   BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX_RAW)
342:     {
343:       bk7258_boottrace_secondary(BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX_EXIT);
344:     }
345: 
346:   return OK;
347: }

400:   memset(g_rx_desc, 0, sizeof(g_rx_desc));
401:   g_rx_order = 0;
402:   g_processing_order = 0;
403:   memset(&g_stats, 0, sizeof(g_stats));

405:   /* CPU1 owns channel 1 and FIFO entries 2..4.  Install the callback and
406:    * descriptors before enabling the route; pre-existing FIFO entries are
407:    * then processed normally instead of being blindly discarded.

410:   putreg32(2u | BK7258_MBOX_CFG_INT_EN | BK7258_MBOX_CFG_WRERR_EN |
411:             BK7258_MBOX_CFG_RDERR_EN | BK7258_MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_EN,
412:             BK7258_MBOX_CH1_CFG);
413:   putreg32(1u | (3u << 1), BK7258_MBOX_CH1_FIFO_CFG);
414: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP

416:             BK7258_MBOX_CFG_RDERR_EN | BK7258_MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_EN,
417:             BK7258_MBOX_CH2_CFG);
418:   putreg32(1u | (3u << 1), BK7258_MBOX_CH2_FIFO_CFG);
419: #endif
420:   modifyreg32(BK7258_MBOX_CTRL, 0, 1u << 2);

424:   if (ret < 0)
425:     {
426:       return ret;
427:     }

429:   g_mbox_ready = true;
430: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
431:   g_mbox_smp_ready = true;
432: #endif
433:   modifyreg32(BK7258_CPU1_IRQ_EN1, 0, 1u << 31);
434:   up_enable_irq(BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX);
435:   return OK;
436: }

57: static void mbox0_reap_slots(u8 dst)

60: 	uint32_t fifo_count;
61: 	u32 reaped = 0;
62: 	u32 now;
63: 	u8 i;
64:

66: 		return;
67:

69: 	if (fifo_count != 0)

72: 		return;
73: 	}
74: 
75: 	now = rtos_get_time();
76: 	if (!slots->fifo_empty_since_ms)
77: 	{
78: 		slots->fifo_empty_since_ms = now ? now : 1;
79: 		return;
80: 	}
81: 	if ((u32)(now - slots->fifo_empty_since_ms) <
82: 		MBOX0_SLOT_QUARANTINE_MS)
83: 		return;
84: 
85: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_CMD_SLOT_NUM; i++)
86: 	{
87: 		reaped += slots->cmd_used[i] != 0;
88: 		slots->cmd_used[i] = 0;
89: 	}
90: 	/* The hardware FIFO contains pointers into these slots.  Once it has
91: 	 * remained empty for the quarantine interval, the peer has had ample time
92: 	 * to copy every published entry.  ACK-only AP traffic has no later command
93: 	 * fence, so retaining these slots indefinitely exhausts the pool during
94: 	 * RESET/STATE/PWC bring-up.
95: 	 */
96: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_ACK_SLOT_NUM; i++)
97: 	{

99: 		slots->ack_used[i] = 0;
100: 	}
101: 	reaped += slots->reset_used != 0;
102: 	reaped += slots->sync_used != 0;
103: 	slots->reset_used = 0;
104: 	slots->sync_used = 0;
105: 	slots->cmd_active = 0;
106: 	slots->fifo_empty_since_ms = 0;
107: 	adapter_diag.tx_reaped += reaped;

258: static void mbox0_rx_isr(mbox0_message_t *msg)
259: {
260: 	u32 address;
261: 	u32 source;
262: 	u32 reaped = 0;
263: 	mbox0_rx_desc_t *desc;
264: 	u8 ctrl;
265: 	u8 i;

274: 		return;
275: 	}
276: 	if (msg->data[1] != sizeof(mailbox_data_t))
277: 	{
278: 		adapter_diag.bad_length++;
279: 		return;
280: 	}
281: 
282: 	address = msg->data[0];
283: 	if (address & 0x3u)
284: 	{
285: 		adapter_diag.bad_alignment++;
286: 		return;
287: 	}
288: 	if (address > UINT32_MAX - sizeof(mailbox_data_t) ||
289: 		address < MBOX0_AP_RAM_START ||
290: 		address + sizeof(mailbox_data_t) > MBOX0_AP_RAM_END)
291: 	{
292: 		adapter_diag.bad_address++;
293: 		return;
294: 	}
295: 	if (rx_count >= MBOX0_RX_DESC_NUM)
296: 	{
297: 		adapter_diag.descriptor_overflow++;
298: 		return;
299: 	}
300: 
301: #if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
302: 	SCB_InvalidateDCache_by_Addr((void *)address, sizeof(mailbox_data_t));
303: #endif
304: 	__DMB();
305: 	desc = NULL;
306: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_RX_DESC_NUM; i++)
307: 	{
308: 		if (!rx_desc[i].used)
309: 		{
310: 			desc = &rx_desc[i];
311: 			break;
312: 		}
313: 	}
314: 	if (!desc)
315: 	{
316: 		adapter_diag.descriptor_overflow++;
317: 		return;
318: 	}
319: 	memcpy(&desc->data, (void *)address, sizeof(desc->data));
320: 	adapter_diag.last_rx_header = desc->data.param0;
321: 	ctrl = (desc->data.param0 >> 12) & 0x0f;
322: 	if (ctrl == 0)
323: 	{
324: 		/* AP serializes ordinary logical commands.  Receiving the next one
325: 		 * proves that it copied the preceding CP transport ACK, providing an
326: 		 * exact lifetime fence even during a continuous UART/PWC burst. */
327: 		for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_ACK_SLOT_NUM; i++)
328: 		{
329: 			reaped += mailbox_slots[source].ack_used[i] != 0;
330: 			mailbox_slots[source].ack_used[i] = 0;
331: 		}
332: 		adapter_diag.tx_reaped += reaped;
333: 	}
334: 	desc->source = source;
335: 	desc->order = ++rx_order;
336: 	desc->used = 1;
337: 	rx_count++;
338: 	adapter_diag.rx_accepted++;
339: 
340: }

738: reset/timeout都会清除门禁并请求回退到CP CLI。使用方式：

228: 	 * A command must not be consumed and its business callback run if its
229: 	 * transport ACK cannot be queued. */

233: static void mb_chnl_ack_retry(void)
234: {
235: 	u16 chnl_type = MB_PHY_ACK_CHNL;
236: 
237: 	while (1)
238: 	{
239: 		mb_ack_entry_t entry;
240: 		bk_err_t ret;
241: 		u32 flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
242: 
243: 		if (!ack_count || ack_sending)
244: 		{
245: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
246: 			return;
247: 		}
248: 		entry = ack_queue[ack_read];
249: 		ack_sending = 1;
250: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
251: 
252: 		ret = bk_mailbox_send_safe(&entry.data, SELF_CPU,
253: 			(mailbox_endpoint_t)entry.destination, &chnl_type);
254: 		flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
255: 		if (ret != BK_OK)
256: 		{
257: 			phy_chnl_x_cb[entry.destination].ack_retry_cnt++;
258: 			ack_sending = 0;
259: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
260: 			return;
261: 		}
262: 		ack_read = (ack_read + 1) % MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN;
263: 		ack_count--;
264: 		ack_sending = 0;
265: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
266: 		s_mailbox_rx_ack_cnt++;
267: 		mb_chnl_notify((mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[entry.destination],
268: 			phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[entry.destination],
269: 			MB_CHNL_EVENT_RX_ACK_SENT);
270: 	}
271: }

273: static bool mb_chnl_ack_enqueue(u8 destination, const mailbox_data_t *data)

279: 	{
280: 		phy_chnl_x_cb[destination].ack_queue_full_cnt++;
281: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
282: 		return false;
283: 	}
284: 	entry = &ack_queue[ack_write];
285: 	entry->data = *data;
286: 	entry->destination = destination;
287: 	ack_write = (ack_write + 1) % MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN;
288: 	ack_count++;
289: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
290: 	mb_chnl_ack_retry();
291: 	return true;
292: }

379: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param1 = cmd_ptr->param1;
380: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param2 = cmd_ptr->param2;
381: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param3 = cmd_ptr->param3;

387: 
388: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
389: 
390: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)

392: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
393: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
394: 
395: 		return ret_code;
396: 	}

398: 	s_mailbox_tx_cnt++;

400: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
401: 
402: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr != NULL)
403: 	{
404: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param);  	/* phy_chnl is BUSY now, tx_isr will not trigger phy_chnl_start_tx. */
405: 	}

410: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(mb_phy_chnl_ack_t *ack_ptr)
411: {
412: 	u8		log_chnl;
413: 	u8		ret_code;
414: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
415: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
416: 
417: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
418: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;

420: 	log_chnl = ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
421: 	if (ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_RESET)
422: 	{
423: 		mb_chnl_ack_t failure;
424: 
425: 		phy_chnl_idx = GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl);
426: 		if (ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl != (CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX | CHNL_CTRL_RESET) ||
427: 			ack_ptr->hdr.state != 0 || ack_ptr->hdr.cmd != 0 ||
428: 			ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq != 0 || ack_ptr->data1 != 0 ||
429: 			ack_ptr->data2 != 0 || ack_ptr->data3 != 0 ||
430: 			GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl) != SELF_CPU ||
431: 			phy_chnl_idx == SELF_CPU || phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
432: 		{
433: 			s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x10;
434: 			if (phy_chnl_idx < PHY_CHNL_NUM)
435: 				phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx].reset_bad_cnt++;
436: 			return;
437: 		}
438: 
439: 		phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
440: 		phy_chnl_ptr->recovering = 1;
441: 		log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx];
442: 		mb_chnl_notify(log_chnl_cb_x,
443: 				   phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx],
444: 				   MB_CHNL_EVENT_PEER_RESET);
445: 		u32 reset_flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
446: 		if (phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_BUSY)
447: 		{
448: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
449: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
450: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(reset_flags);
451: 			log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl);
452: 			if (log_chnl_idx < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx] &&
453: 				log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr)
454: 			{
455: 				memset(&failure, 0, sizeof(failure));
456: 				failure.hdr.cmd = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd;
457: 				failure.hdr.state = CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;
458: 				log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(
459: 					log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, &failure);
460: 			}
461: 			bk_mailbox_tx_timeout((mailbox_endpoint_t)phy_chnl_idx);
462: 		}

1008: bk_err_t mb_chnl_write(u8 log_chnl, mb_chnl_cmd_t * cmd_buf)
1009: {
1010: 	u16		write_len;
1011: 
1012: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
1013: 	u8		log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);

1015: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
1016: 
1017: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
1018: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
1019: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
1020: #endif
1021: 
1022: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
1023: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
1024: 
1025: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
1026: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
1027: 
1028: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
1029: 
1030: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
1031: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
1032: 
1033: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].in_used == 0)
1034: 		return BK_ERR_STATE;
1035: 
1036: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
1037: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t *phy = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
1038: 	mb_chnl_cmd_t *logical_cmd = cmd_buf;
1039: 
1040: 	if (phy->recovering &&
1041: 		!(log_chnl == MB_CHNL_UART0 &&
1042: 		  logical_cmd->hdr.cmd == MB_UART_STATE_COMMAND))
1043: 	{
1044: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
1045: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
1046: 	}
1047: 
1048: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
1049: 	{
1050: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
1051: 
1052: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
1053: 	}
1054: 
1055: 	write_len = sizeof(mailbox_data_t) > sizeof(mb_chnl_cmd_t) ? sizeof(mb_chnl_cmd_t) : sizeof(mailbox_data_t);
1056: 
1057: 	memset(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, 0,
1058: 	       sizeof(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff));
1059: 	memcpy(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, cmd_buf, write_len);
1060: 
1061: 	/* set to BUSY means there is data in tx-buff. mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr will get it to send. */
1062: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;   /* MUST set to BUSY after data was copied. */
1063: 	__DMB();
1064: 
1065: 	bk_err_t start_ret = mb_phy_chnl_start_tx(log_chnl);
1066: 
1067: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
1068: 
1069: 	return start_ret;
1070: }

1157: void mb_chnl_poll(void)
1158: {
1159: 	u8 phy_idx;
1160: 	u32 poll_flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
1161: 
1162: 	/* The CPU1 boot transaction may poll directly while ap_console is also
1163: 	 * scheduled.  Serialize the whole poll pass without holding the channel
1164: 	 * lock across callbacks and physical sends.
1165: 	 */
1166: 	if (s_poll_active)
1167: 	{
1168: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(poll_flags);
1169: 		return;
1170: 	}
1171: 	s_poll_active = 1;
1172: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(poll_flags);
1173: 
1174: 	bk_mailbox_poll();
1175: 	mb_chnl_ack_retry();
1176: 
1177: 	for (phy_idx = 0; phy_idx < PHY_CHNL_NUM; phy_idx++)
1178: 	{
1179: 		mb_phy_chnl_cb_t *phy = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_idx];
1180: 		mb_log_chnl_cb_t *logs;
1181: 		mb_chnl_ack_t failure;
1182: 		u8 log_idx;
1183: 
1184: 		u32 claim_flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
1185: 		if ((phy->tx_state != CHNL_STATE_BUSY) || !phy->busy_since_ms ||
1186: 			((u32)(rtos_get_time() - phy->busy_since_ms) < MB_PHY_CHNL_BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS))
1187: 		{
1188: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(claim_flags);
1189: 			continue;
1190: 		}
1191: 		phy->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
1192: 		phy->busy_since_ms = 0;
1193: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(claim_flags);
1194: 
1195: 		logs = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_idx];
1196: 		log_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(phy->tx_log_chnl);
1197: 		if (log_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_idx])
1198: 			continue;
1199: 
1200: 		phy->tx_fault_cnt++;
1201: 		phy->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x20000000;
1202: 		bk_mailbox_tx_timeout((mailbox_endpoint_t)phy_idx);
1203: 		phy->recovering = 1;
1204: 		memset(&failure, 0, sizeof(failure));
1205: 		failure.hdr.cmd = phy->tx_hdr_cmd;
1206: 		failure.hdr.state = CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;
1207: 		if (logs[log_idx].tx_cmpl_isr)
1208: 			logs[log_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(logs[log_idx].isr_param, &failure);
1209: 		mb_chnl_fail_pending(logs, phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_idx]);
1210: 		mb_chnl_notify(logs, phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_idx],
1211: 				   MB_CHNL_EVENT_TX_TIMEOUT);
1212: 		if (mb_phy_chnl_send_reset(phy_idx, phy->tx_log_chnl) == BK_OK)
1213: 			mb_chnl_notify(logs, phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_idx],
1214: 					   MB_CHNL_EVENT_ABORT_SENT);
1215: 		else
1216: 			mb_chnl_notify(logs, phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_idx],
1217: 					   MB_CHNL_EVENT_ABORT_FAILED);
1218: 	}
1219: 
1220: 	poll_flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
1221: 	s_poll_active = 0;
1222: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(poll_flags);
1223: }

154: static u8 cal_crc8_0x31(u8 *data_buf, u16 len)
155: {
156: 	u8    crc = 0x00;
157: 
158: #if MB_UART_CRC8_ENABLE
159: 	for (u16 i = 0; i < len; i++)
160: 	{
161: 		crc = crc8_table[crc ^ data_buf[i]];
162: 	}
163: #endif
164: 
165: 	return (crc);
166: }

204: static bool mb_uart_validate_command(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb,
205: 				     mb_uart_cmd_t *uart_cmd, bool data)
206: {
207: 	if (uart_cmd->resvd || uart_cmd->mb_cmd.param3)
208: 		return false;
209: 
210: 	if (data)
211: 	{
212: 		if (uart_cmd->cmd_buff != chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff ||
213: 			uart_cmd->cmd_data_len < 1 ||
214: 			uart_cmd->cmd_data_len > UART_XCHG_DATA_MAX)
215: 			return false;
216: 		return uart_cmd->crc8 == cal_crc8_0x31((u8 *)uart_cmd->cmd_buff,
217: 							 uart_cmd->cmd_data_len);
218: 	}
219: 
220: 	return uart_cmd->cmd_buff == NULL && uart_cmd->cmd_data_len == 0 &&
221: 		uart_cmd->crc8 == 0;
222: }

224: static void rx_isr_data_handler(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_uart_cmd_t * uart_cmd)
225: {
226: 	u8      tx_fail = 0;
227: 
228: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx, free_cnt;
229: 
230: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx;
231: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx;
232: 
233: 	if(rd_idx > wr_idx)
234: 	{
235: 		free_cnt = rd_idx - wr_idx - 1;  // always reserved one byte space.
236: 	}
237: 	else
238: 	{
239: 		free_cnt = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - (wr_idx - rd_idx) - 1;
240: 	}
241: 
242: 	if(!mb_uart_validate_command(chnl_cb, uart_cmd, true))
243: 	{
244: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_PROTOCOL_ERR;
245: 		chnl_cb->bad_command_count++;
246: 		tx_fail = 1;
247: 		goto rx_isr_data_xit;
248: 	}
249: 
250: 	if(uart_cmd->cmd_data_len > free_cnt)
251: 	{
252: 		chnl_cb->status_overflow = 1;   /* discards all rx-data.  */
253: 		tx_fail = 1;
254: 
255: 		goto rx_isr_data_xit;
256: 	}
257: 
258: 	#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
259: 	flush_dcache(uart_cmd->cmd_buff, uart_cmd->cmd_data_len);
260: 	#endif
261: 
262: 	u16    rem_len, cpy_len;
263: 
264: 	cpy_len = uart_cmd->cmd_data_len;
265: 
266: 	if(wr_idx < rd_idx)
267: 	{
268: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, cpy_len);
269: 		chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx += cpy_len;
270: 	}
271: 	else
272: 	{
273: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - wr_idx;
274: 
275: 		if(rd_idx == 0)
276: 			rem_len -= 1;  // if rx_idx == 0, reserved one byte at tail of the array.
277: 
278: 		if(rem_len > cpy_len)
279: 		{
280: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, cpy_len);
281: 			chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx += cpy_len;
282: 		}
283: 		else
284: 		{
285: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, rem_len);
286: 
287: 			if(rem_len < cpy_len)
288: 			{
289: 				memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf, uart_cmd->cmd_buff + rem_len, cpy_len - rem_len);
290: 			}
291: 
292: 			chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx = cpy_len - rem_len;
293: 		}
294: 	}
295: 
296: 	free_cnt -= cpy_len;
297: 
298: 	if(chnl_cb->rx_isr_callback != NULL)
299: 	{
300: 		chnl_cb->rx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->rx_isr_param);
301: 	}
302: 
303: rx_isr_data_xit:
304: 
305: 	if(free_cnt <= MB_UART_RX_FIFO_LEN)
306: 	{
307: 		chnl_cb->ctrl_rts = 1;
308: 	}
309: 
310: 	u8      old_cts = chnl_cb->status_cts;
311: 
312: 	chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_cmd->uart_rts;
313: 
314: 	/* overwrite the uart_cmd after the ISR handle completed.
315: 	 * return the rsp info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
316: 	 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
317: 	 */
318: 	u8 cmd = uart_cmd->chnl_hdr.cmd;
319: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)uart_cmd;
320: 	memset(uart_rsp, 0, sizeof(*uart_rsp));
321: 	uart_rsp->chnl_hdr.cmd = cmd;
322: 	uart_rsp->uart_rts = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
323: 	uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail = tx_fail;
324: 	uart_rsp->resvd = 0;
325: 
326: 	if(chnl_cb->status_cts != old_cts)
327: 	{
328: 		if(chnl_cb->status_cts == 0)
329: 		{
330: 			/* trigger send! */
331: 			mb_uart_send_data_trigger(chnl_cb);
332: 		}
333: 	}
334: 
335: 	return;
336: }

338: static void rx_isr_state_handler(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_uart_cmd_t *uart_cmd)
339: {
340: 	u8      old_cts = chnl_cb->status_cts;
341: 	u8 cmd = uart_cmd->chnl_hdr.cmd;
342: 	u8 invalid = !mb_uart_validate_command(chnl_cb, uart_cmd, false);
343: 
344: 	if (!invalid)
345: 		chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_cmd->uart_rts;
346: 	else
347: 	{
348: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_PROTOCOL_ERR;
349: 		chnl_cb->bad_command_count++;
350: 	}
351: 
352: 	/* overwrite the uart_cmd after the ISR handle completed.
353: 	 * return the rsp info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
354: 	 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
355: 	 */
356: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)uart_cmd;
357: 	memset(uart_rsp, 0, sizeof(*uart_rsp));
358: 	uart_rsp->chnl_hdr.cmd = cmd;
359: 	uart_rsp->uart_rts = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
360: 	uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail = invalid;
361: 	uart_rsp->resvd = 0;
362: 
363: 	if(chnl_cb->status_cts != old_cts)
364: 	{
365: 		if(chnl_cb->status_cts == 0)
366: 		{
367: 			/* trigger send! */
368: 			mb_uart_send_data_trigger(chnl_cb);
369: 		}
370: 	}
371: 
372: 	return;
373: }

375: static void mb_uart_rx_isr(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_buf)
376: {
377: 	/* The response carries the current RTS state, but it cannot replace an
378: 	 * outstanding ACK-pool fence.
379: 	 */
380: 	if (!chnl_cb->tx_fence_req)
381: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
382: 
383: 	if(cmd_buf->hdr.cmd == MB_UART_SEND_DATA)
384: 	{
385: 		rx_isr_data_handler(chnl_cb, (mb_uart_cmd_t *)cmd_buf);
386: 	}
387: 	else if(cmd_buf->hdr.cmd == MB_UART_SEND_STATE)
388: 	{
389: 		rx_isr_state_handler(chnl_cb, (mb_uart_cmd_t *)cmd_buf);
390: 	}
391: 	else
392: 	{
393: 		/* overwrite the cmd_buf after the ISR handle completed.
394: 		 * return the ack info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
395: 		 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
396: 		 */
397: 		mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)cmd_buf;
398: 		u8 cmd = cmd_buf->hdr.cmd;
399: 		memset(uart_rsp, 0, sizeof(*uart_rsp));
400: 		uart_rsp->chnl_hdr.cmd = cmd;
401: 		uart_rsp->uart_rts = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
402: 		uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail = 1;
403: 		uart_rsp->resvd = 0;
404: 	}
405: 
406: 	return;
407: }

409: static void mb_uart_tx_cmpl_isr(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_ack_t *ack_buf)  /* tx_cmpl_isr */
410: {
411: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)ack_buf;
412: 
413: 	u8      tx_fail = 0;
414: 
415: 	/* chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == uart_cmd->cmd_buff. MUST be true. */
416: 
417: 	if ((ack_buf->hdr.cmd != chnl_cb->tx_cmd) ||
418: 		(chnl_cb->tx_in_process == 0) )
419: 	{
420: 		chnl_cb->bad_ack_count++;
421: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_PROTOCOL_ERR;
422: 		return;
423: 	}
424: 
425: 	chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_rsp->uart_rts;
426: 
427: 	if(ack_buf->hdr.state & CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL)
428: 	{
429: 		tx_fail = 0x01;
430: 	}
431: 	else if ((uart_rsp->mb_ack.ack_data1 & ~0x3u) ||
432: 		 uart_rsp->mb_ack.ack_data2 || uart_rsp->mb_ack.ack_data3)
433: 	{
434: 		tx_fail = 1;
435: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_PROTOCOL_ERR;
436: 	}
437: 	else
438: 	{
439: 		tx_fail = uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail;
440: 	}
441: 
442: 	if (!tx_fail && chnl_cb->tx_cmd == MB_UART_SEND_DATA)
443: 	{
444: 		chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx = (chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx + chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len) %
445: 					 sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
446: 		chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len = 0;
447: 		chnl_cb->tx_retry = 0;
448: 	}
449: 	else if (!tx_fail && chnl_cb->tx_cmd == MB_UART_SEND_STATE)
450: 	{
451: 		chnl_cb->tx_fence_req = 0;
452: 		if (!chnl_cb->link_ready)
453: 		{
454: 			chnl_cb->link_ready = 1;
455: 			chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_READY;
456: 			chnl_cb->probe_count = 0;
457: 			if (bk_pm_cp1_work_state_get() ==
458: 				PM_MAILBOX_COMMUNICATION_FINISH)
459: 			{
460: 				mb_chnl_recovered(GET_DST_CPU_ID(chnl_cb->chnl_id));
461: 			}
462: 			mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_READY);
463: 		}
464: 	}
465: 
466: 	if (tx_fail)
467: 	{
468: 		if (chnl_cb->tx_cmd == MB_UART_SEND_DATA)
469: 		{
470: 			if (chnl_cb->tx_retry)
471: 			{
472: 				chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx = (chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx +
473: 						      chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len) %
474: 						     sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
475: 				chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len = 0;
476: 				chnl_cb->tx_retry = 0;
477: 			}
478: 			else
479: 			{
480: 				chnl_cb->tx_retry = 1;
481: 			}
482: 		}
483: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_TX_FAIL;
484: 		chnl_cb->link_ready = 0;
485: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;
486: 		if (chnl_cb->probe_count < MB_UART_PROBE_MAX)
487: 		{
488: 			chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_PROBING;
489: 			chnl_cb->probe_due_ms = rtos_get_time() + MB_UART_PROBE_RETRY_MS;
490: 			chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 1;
491: 		}
492: 		else
493: 		{
494: 			chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_DOWN;
495: 			chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
496: 			chnl_cb->probe_due_ms = rtos_get_time() +
497: 				MB_UART_DOWN_RETRY_MS;
498: 		}
499: 		mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_DOWN);
500: 		if (chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback)
501: 			chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->tx_isr_param);
502: 		return;
503: 	}
504: 
505: 	/* try next Tx. */
506: 
507: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
508: 
509: 	if (chnl_cb->tx_state_req)
510: 	{
511: 		ret_val = mb_uart_send_state(chnl_cb);
512: 		if (ret_val == BK_OK)
513: 			chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
514: 	}
515: 	if (ret_val != BK_OK)
516: 		ret_val = mb_uart_send_data(chnl_cb);
517: 
518: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
519: 	{
520: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;  /* clear here, because no tx_cmpl_isr callback! */
521: 	}
522: 
523: 	if(chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback != NULL)
524: 	{
525: 		chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->tx_isr_param);
526: 	}
527: 
528: 	return;
529: }

531: static void mb_uart_channel_event(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_event_t event)
532: {
533: 	if (event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_RX_ACK_SENT)
534: 	{
535: 		u8 peer = GET_DST_CPU_ID(chnl_cb->chnl_id);
536: 
537: 		if (!chnl_cb->tx_fence_req &&
538: 			bk_mailbox_ack_slots_used((mailbox_endpoint_t)peer) >=
539: 			MB_UART_ACK_FENCE_WATERMARK)
540: 		{
541: 			chnl_cb->tx_fence_req = 1;
542: 			chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 1;
543: 		}
544: 	}
545: 	else if (event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_ABORT_SENT)
546: 	{
547: 		chnl_cb->link_ready = 0;
548: 		chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_PROBING;
549: 		chnl_cb->probe_count = 0;
550: 		chnl_cb->probe_due_ms = rtos_get_time();
551: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 1;
552: 	}
553: 	else if (event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_ABORT_FAILED)
554: 	{
555: 		chnl_cb->link_ready = 0;
556: 		chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_DOWN;
557: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
558: 		mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_DOWN);
559: 	}
560: 	else
561: 	{
562: 		if (chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len)
563: 		{
564: 			/* Delivery is unknowable after a lost ACK. Drop this chunk instead
565: 			 * of replaying terminal input and making duplicate commands. */
566: 			chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx = (chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx +
567: 					      chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len) %
568: 					     sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
569: 			chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len = 0;
570: 			chnl_cb->tx_retry = 0;
571: 			chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_TX_FAIL;
572: 		}
573: 		chnl_cb->link_ready = 0;
574: 		chnl_cb->probe_count = 0;
575: 		chnl_cb->probe_due_ms = rtos_get_time();
576: 		chnl_cb->link_state = event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_TX_TIMEOUT ?
577: 			MB_UART_LINK_ABORTING : MB_UART_LINK_PROBING;
578: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_PEER_RESET;
579: 		if (event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_PEER_RESET)
580: 			mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_PEER_RESET);
581: 		else
582: 			mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_TIMEOUT);
583: 	}
584: 
585: 	if (chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback)
586: 		chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->tx_isr_param);
587: }

589: static bk_err_t mb_uart_init(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 chnl_id)
590: {
591: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
592: 
593: 	if(chnl_cb->chnl_inited)
594: 		return BK_OK;
595: 
596: 	memset(chnl_cb, 0, sizeof(mb_uart_cb_t));
597: 	chnl_cb->chnl_id = chnl_id;
598: 	chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_PROBING;
599: 	chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 1;
600: 
601: 	chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff = mb_chnl_get_tx_buff(chnl_id);
602: 	chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff = mb_chnl_get_rx_buff(chnl_id);
603: 
604: 	if( (chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff == NULL) ||
605: 		(chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == NULL) )
606: 	{
607: 		return BK_FAIL;
608: 	}
609: 
610: 	ret_code = mb_chnl_open(chnl_id, chnl_cb);
611: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
612: 	{
613: 		return ret_code;
614: 	}
615: 
616: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_RX_ISR, (void *)mb_uart_rx_isr);
617: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_TX_CMPL_ISR, (void *)mb_uart_tx_cmpl_isr);
618: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_TX_ISR, NULL);
619: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_EVENT_ISR, (void *)mb_uart_channel_event);
620: 
621: 	chnl_cb->chnl_inited = 1;
622: 
623: 	return BK_OK;
624: }

626: static bk_err_t mb_uart_deinit(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 chnl_id)
627: {
628: 	if(!chnl_cb->chnl_inited)
629: 		return BK_OK;
630: 
631: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_RX_ISR, NULL);
632: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_TX_CMPL_ISR, NULL);
633: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_TX_ISR, NULL);
634: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_EVENT_ISR, NULL);

636: 	mb_chnl_close(chnl_id);
637: 
638: 	chnl_cb->rx_isr_callback = NULL;
639: 	chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback = NULL;
640: 
641: 	chnl_cb->chnl_inited = 0;
642: 
643: 	return BK_OK;
644: }

646: static bk_err_t mb_uart_send_data(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb)
647: {
648: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
649: 
650: 	u16    rem_len, cpy_len;
651: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx;
652: 
653: 	if(chnl_cb->status_cts != 0)
654: 	{
655: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
656: 	}
657: 
658: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx;
659: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->tx_wr_idx;
660: 
661: 	if(rd_idx <= wr_idx)
662: 	{
663: 		cpy_len = wr_idx - rd_idx;
664: 	}
665: 	else
666: 	{
667: 		cpy_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - (rd_idx - wr_idx);
668: 	}
669: 
670: 	if(cpy_len == 0)
671: 	{
672: 		return BK_FAIL;
673: 	}
674: 
675: 	if(cpy_len > MB_UART_TX_FIFO_LEN)
676: 	{
677: 		cpy_len = MB_UART_TX_FIFO_LEN;
678: 	}
679: 
680: 	if(rd_idx < wr_idx)
681: 	{
682: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, cpy_len);
683: 	}
684: 	else
685: 	{
686: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - rd_idx;
687:

804: 	if(rd_idx > wr_idx)

807: 	}

811: 	}

819: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf + wr_idx, data_buf, wr_len);
820: 	}
821: 	else
822: 	{
823: 		if(rd_idx != 0)
824: 			rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - wr_idx;  // if rx_idx == 0, reserved one byte at tail of the array.

134: static void ap_bridge_log_output(const u8 *line, u16 length, bool prefix_line)
135: {
136: 	static const u8 prefix[] = "ap0: ";
137: 	u8 output[sizeof(prefix) - 1 + AP_BRIDGE_LOG_LINE_SIZE];
138: 	u16 output_length;
139: 	u8 retry;
140: 
141: 	output_length = 0;
142: 	if (prefix_line)
143: 	{
144: 		memcpy(output, prefix, sizeof(prefix) - 1);
145: 		output_length = sizeof(prefix) - 1;
146: 	}
147: 	memcpy(output + output_length, line, length);
148: 	output_length += length;
149: 	for (retry = 0; retry < AP_BRIDGE_LOG_RETRY_MAX; retry++)
150: 	{
151: 		if (shell_log_raw_data(output, output_length))
152: 			return;
153: 		rtos_delay_milliseconds(AP_BRIDGE_LOG_RETRY_MS);

165: static void ap_bridge_drain_tx(void)
166: {
167: 	u8 data[MB_CHNL_BUFF_LEN];
168: 	u16 count;
169: 	u16 length;
170: 	u16 written;
171: 	u16 i;
172: 
173: 	while (s_ap_bridge.link_ready)
174: 	{
175: 		rtos_lock_mutex(&s_ap_bridge.tx_mutex);
176: 		count = ap_bridge_tx_count();
177: 		if (!count)
178: 		{
179: 			rtos_unlock_mutex(&s_ap_bridge.tx_mutex);
180: 			break;
181: 		}
182: 		length = MIN(count, (u16)sizeof(data));
183: 		length = MIN(length, bk_mb_uart_write_ready(MB_UART0));
184: 		if (!length)
185: 		{
186: 			rtos_unlock_mutex(&s_ap_bridge.tx_mutex);
187: 			break;
188: 		}
189: 
190: 		for (i = 0; i < length; i++)
191: 			data[i] = s_ap_bridge.tx_ring[(s_ap_bridge.tx_rd + i) %
192: 							 sizeof(s_ap_bridge.tx_ring)];
193: 
194: 		written = bk_mb_uart_write(MB_UART0, data, length);
195: 		if (!written)
196: 		{
197: 			rtos_unlock_mutex(&s_ap_bridge.tx_mutex);
198: 			break;
199: 		}
200: 		if (written < length)
201: 			s_ap_bridge.stats.tx_partial++;
202: 
203: 		s_ap_bridge.tx_rd = (s_ap_bridge.tx_rd + written) %
204: 					 sizeof(s_ap_bridge.tx_ring);
205: 		s_ap_bridge.stats.tx_bytes += written;
206: 		rtos_unlock_mutex(&s_ap_bridge.tx_mutex);
207: 	}
208: }

210: static void ap_bridge_task(beken_thread_arg_t arg)
211: {
212: 	u8 input[MB_CHNL_BUFF_LEN];
213: 	u8 line[AP_BRIDGE_LOG_LINE_SIZE];
214: 	u16 line_length = 0;
215: 	u8 active_mode = AP_CONSOLE_OUTPUT_LOG;
216: 	bool line_continues = false;
217: 
218: 	(void)arg;
219: 	for (;;)
220: 	{
221: 		u32 events;
222: 		u32 flags;
223: 		u16 input_length;
224: 		u16 index;
225: 		u8 ready_set;
226: 		u8 ready_clear;
227: 		u8 ready_before;
228: 		bk_err_t ret = rtos_get_semaphore(&s_ap_bridge.sem,
229: 			line_length ? AP_BRIDGE_LOG_FLUSH_MS : 20);
230: 
231: 		bk_mb_uart_poll(MB_UART0);
232: 
233: 		flags = rtos_disable_int();
234: 		events = s_ap_bridge.events;
235: 		s_ap_bridge.events = 0;
236: 		ready_set = s_ap_bridge.ready_set;
237: 		ready_clear = s_ap_bridge.ready_clear;
238: 		ready_before = s_ap_bridge.ready_flags;
239: 		s_ap_bridge.ready_set = 0;
240: 		s_ap_bridge.ready_clear = 0;
241: 		rtos_enable_int(flags);
242: 
243: 		if (events & (AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_DOWN | AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_RESET |
244: 			      AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_TIMEOUT))
245: 		{
246: 			ready_clear |= AP_BRIDGE_READY_MBUART;
247: 		}
248: 		s_ap_bridge.ready_flags |= ready_set;
249: 		s_ap_bridge.ready_flags &= ~ready_clear;
250: 		/* poll() may complete recovery in the same iteration that consumes an
251: 		 * older timeout/reset event.  The driver's current state is the final
252: 		 * authority for the MBUART gate, so a stale event cannot clear a newer
253: 		 * READY notification permanently.
254: 		 */
255: 		if (bk_mb_uart_is_link_ready(MB_UART0))
256: 			s_ap_bridge.ready_flags |= AP_BRIDGE_READY_MBUART;
257: 		else
258: 			s_ap_bridge.ready_flags &= ~AP_BRIDGE_READY_MBUART;
259: 		s_ap_bridge.link_ready =
260: 			(s_ap_bridge.ready_flags & AP_BRIDGE_READY_ALL) ==
261: 			AP_BRIDGE_READY_ALL && bk_mb_uart_is_link_ready(MB_UART0);
262: 
263: 		if (s_ap_bridge.mode_applied_generation !=
264: 			s_ap_bridge.mode_generation)
265: 		{
266: 			if (line_length)
267: 				ap_bridge_log_output(line, line_length, !line_continues);
268: 			line_length = 0;
269: 			line_continues = false;
270: 			active_mode = s_ap_bridge.requested_mode;
271: 			s_ap_bridge.output_mode = active_mode;
272: 			s_ap_bridge.mode_applied_generation =
273: 				s_ap_bridge.mode_generation;
274: 			rtos_set_semaphore(&s_ap_bridge.mode_sem);
275: 		}
276: 
277: 		do
278: 		{
279: 			input_length = bk_mb_uart_read(MB_UART0, input, sizeof(input));
280: 			s_ap_bridge.stats.rx_bytes += input_length;
281: 			if (active_mode == AP_CONSOLE_OUTPUT_RAW)
282: 			{
283: 				if (input_length && !shell_log_raw_data(input, input_length))
284: 					s_ap_bridge.stats.rx_queue_fail++;
285: 				continue;
286: 			}
287: 
288: 			for (index = 0; index < input_length; index++)
289: 			{
290: 				line[line_length++] = input[index];
291: 				if (input[index] == '\n' || line_length == sizeof(line))
292: 				{
293: 					bool complete = input[index] == '\n';
294: 
295: 					ap_bridge_log_output(line, line_length,
296: 							     !line_continues);
297: 					line_length = 0;
298: 					line_continues = !complete;
299: 				}
300: 			}
301: 		} while (input_length != 0);
302: 
303: 		if (ret == kTimeoutErr && line_length &&
304: 			active_mode == AP_CONSOLE_OUTPUT_LOG)
305: 		{
306: 			ap_bridge_log_output(line, line_length, !line_continues);
307: 			line_length = 0;
308: 			line_continues = true;
309: 		}
310: 
311: 		ap_bridge_drain_tx();
312: 
313: 		if (events & (AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_DOWN | AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_RESET |
314: 			      AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_TIMEOUT))
315: 		{
316: 			u32 now = rtos_get_time();
317: 
318: 			s_ap_bridge.stats.link_down++;
319: 			if (events & AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_RESET)
320: 				s_ap_bridge.stats.reset++;
321: 			if (events & AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_TIMEOUT)
322: 				s_ap_bridge.stats.timeout++;
323: 			if ((ready_before & (AP_BRIDGE_READY_IPC |
324: 					     AP_BRIDGE_READY_PWC)) ==
325: 				(AP_BRIDGE_READY_IPC | AP_BRIDGE_READY_PWC) &&
326: 				(u32)(now - s_ap_bridge.last_down_log_ms) >= 1000)
327: 			{
328: 				s_ap_bridge.last_down_log_ms = now;
329: 				BK_LOGW(AP_BRIDGE_TAG,
330: 					"link down event=%x queued=%u ready=%x\r\n",
331: 					events, ap_bridge_tx_count(),
332: 					s_ap_bridge.ready_flags);
333: 			}
334: 			shell_ap_console_link_down();
335: 		}
336: 	}
337: }

381: 	if (ret != BK_OK)

385: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&s_ap_bridge.mode_sem);
386: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&s_ap_bridge.sem);
387: 		goto init_fail_mutex;

390: 	ap_bridge_wake(AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_RX | AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_TX);

392: 		(unsigned)sizeof(s_ap_bridge.tx_ring));

404: u16 ap_console_bridge_write(const u8 *data, u16 length)
405: {
406: 	u16 written = 0;
407: 
408: 	if (!data || !length || !s_ap_bridge.link_ready)
409: 		return 0;
410: 
411: 	rtos_lock_mutex(&s_ap_bridge.tx_mutex);
412: 	while (written < length)
413: 	{
414: 		u16 next = (s_ap_bridge.tx_wr + 1) % sizeof(s_ap_bridge.tx_ring);
415: 		if (next == s_ap_bridge.tx_rd)
416: 			break;
417: 		s_ap_bridge.tx_ring[s_ap_bridge.tx_wr] = data[written++];
418: 		s_ap_bridge.tx_wr = next;
419: 	}
420: 	rtos_unlock_mutex(&s_ap_bridge.tx_mutex);
421: 	if (written < length)
422: 	{
423: 		s_ap_bridge.stats.tx_drop += length - written;
424: 	}
425: 	if (written)
426: 		ap_bridge_wake(AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_TX);
427: 	return written;
428: }

233:               g_uart.tx_retry_count = 0;
234:               g_uart.stats.tx_retry_drop++;
235:             }
236:         }
237: 
238:       g_uart.tx_inflight = 0;
239:     }
240:   else if (command == BK7258_MB_UART_STATE && failed)
241:     {
242:       g_uart.stats.remote_fail++;
243:       /* The transport invokes this completion before it changes READY to
244:        * ABORTING.  Always retain a STATE request so RESET recovery has a
245:        * probe to send after it reaches PROBING.
246:        */
247: 
248:       g_uart.state_pending = true;
249:     }
250: 
251:   g_uart.transaction_busy = false;
252:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
253:   nxsem_post(&g_uart.worker_sem);

256: static int mb_uart_receive(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
257:                            uint8_t *ack_flags, void *arg)
258: {
259:   uint8_t command = bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message);
260:   uint16_t length = message->payload_length;
261:   uint16_t first;
262:   bool failed = false;
263:   bool malformed = false;
264: 
265:   (void)arg;
266:   if (ack_flags == NULL)
267:     {
268:       return -EINVAL;
269:     }
270: 
271:   if (command != BK7258_MB_UART_DATA && command != BK7258_MB_UART_STATE)
272:     {
273:       g_uart.stats.bad_flags++;
274:       failed = true;
275:       malformed = true;
276:     }
277:   else if ((message->flags & ~1u) != 0)
278:     {
279:       g_uart.stats.bad_flags++;
280:       failed = true;
281:       malformed = true;
282:     }
283:   else if (message->crc8 != 0)
284:     {
285:       g_uart.stats.bad_crc++;
286:       g_uart.sticky_status |= MB_UART_STATUS_PARITY;
287:       failed = true;
288:       malformed = true;
289:     }
290:   else if (message->reserved != 0)
291:     {
292:       g_uart.stats.bad_reserved++;
293:       failed = true;
294:       malformed = true;
295:     }
296: 
297:   if (!failed && command == BK7258_MB_UART_DATA)
298:     {
299:       if (message->payload_address != BK7258_MB_UART_RX_ADDRESS)
300:         {
301:           g_uart.stats.bad_pointer++;
302:           failed = true;
303:           malformed = true;
304:         }
305:       else if (length == 0 || length > BK7258_MB_UART_CHUNK_SIZE)
306:         {
307:           g_uart.stats.bad_length++;
308:           failed = true;
309:           malformed = true;
310:         }
311:       else if (!bk7258_mailbox_link_ready())
312:         {
313:           failed = true;
314:         }
315:       else if (rx_free() < length)
316:         {
317:           g_uart.stats.rx_overflow++;
318:           g_uart.sticky_status |= MB_UART_STATUS_OVF;
319:           failed = true;
320:         }
321:       else
322:         {
323:           const uint8_t *source =
324:             (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)BK7258_MB_UART_RX_ADDRESS;
325: 
326:           __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
327:           first = MB_UART_RX_SIZE - g_uart.rx_write;
328:           if (first > length)
329:             {
330:               first = length;
331:             }
332: 
333:           memcpy(&g_uart.rx_ring[g_uart.rx_write], source, first);
334:           if (first != length)
335:             {
336:               memcpy(g_uart.rx_ring, source + first, length - first);
337:             }
338: 
339:           g_uart.rx_write = (g_uart.rx_write + length) % MB_UART_RX_SIZE;
340:           g_uart.stats.data_rx++;
341:           g_uart.stats.rx_bytes += length;
342:         }
343:     }
344:   else if (!failed)
345:     {
346:       if (message->payload_address != 0 || message->payload_length != 0)
347:         {
348:           g_uart.stats.bad_length++;
349:           failed = true;
350:           malformed = true;
351:         }
352:       else
353:         {
354:           g_uart.stats.state_rx++;
355:         }
356:     }
357: 
358:   if (!malformed)
359:     {
360:       bool old_peer_rts = g_uart.peer_rts;
361: 
362:       g_uart.peer_rts = (message->flags & 1u) != 0;
363:       g_uart.peer_rts_known = true;
364:       if (old_peer_rts && !g_uart.peer_rts)
365:         {
366:           nxsem_post(&g_uart.worker_sem);
367:         }
368:     }
369: 
370:   update_local_rts();
371:   *ack_flags = (g_uart.local_rts ? 1u : 0u) | (failed ? 2u : 0u);
372:   nxsem_post(&g_uart.worker_sem);
373:   return malformed ? -EPROTO : OK;
374: }

90: static int ipc_send(uint8_t command, uint32_t parameter)
91: {
92:   struct bk7258_mb_wire_message message;
93:   volatile uint32_t *payload =
94:     (volatile uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)BK7258_IPC_TX_ADDRESS;
95:   int ret;
96: 
97:   ret = nxmutex_lock(&g_ipc_lock);
98:   if (ret < 0)
99:     {
100:       return ret;
101:     }
102: 
103:   *payload = parameter;
104:   __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
105: 
106:   memset(&message, 0, sizeof(message));
107:   message.header = command;
108:   message.payload_address = BK7258_IPC_TX_ADDRESS;
109:   message.payload_length =
110:     command == IPC_CPU1_HEART_BEAT_INDICATION ? sizeof(*payload) : 0;
111:   g_ipc_ack_result = -EINPROGRESS;
112: 
113:   ret = bk7258_mailbox_send_wire(BK7258_MB_CHAN_HW_CTRL_TX, &message,
114:                                   ipc_tx_complete,
115:                                   (void *)(uintptr_t)command);
116:   if (ret == OK)
117:     {
118:       ret = bk7258_mailbox_wait_hw_control(IPC_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT_MS);
119:       if (ret == OK)
120:         {
121:           ret = g_ipc_ack_result;
122:         }
123:     }
124: 
125:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_ipc_lock);
126:   return ret > 0 ? -EIO : ret;
127: }

129: static int ipc_heartbeat_worker(int argc, char **argv)
130: {
131:   int ret;
132: 
133:   (void)argc;
134:   (void)argv;
135: 
136:   ret = bind_worker_to_primary();
137:   if (ret < 0)
138:     {
139:       return -EXDEV;
140:     }
141: 
142:   for (;;)
143:     {
144:       nxsig_usleep(IPC_HEARTBEAT_POLL_US);
145:       bk7258_ipc_heartbeat_poll();
146:     }
147: 
148:   return OK;
149: }

151: void bk7258_ipc_heartbeat_poll(void)
152: {
153:   struct bk7258_mb_wire_message message;
154:   volatile uint32_t *payload =
155:     (volatile uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)BK7258_IPC_TX_ADDRESS;
156:   clock_t now;
157:   int ret;
158: 
159:   if (!g_heartbeat_enabled || g_heartbeat_pending)
160:     {
161:       return;
162:     }
163: 
164:   if (g_heartbeat_completions != g_heartbeat_reported)
165:     {
166:       g_heartbeat_reported = g_heartbeat_completions;
167:       if (g_heartbeat_reported <= 3u)
168:         {
169:           printf("IPC: heartbeat ACK result=%d count=%lu\n",
170:                  g_heartbeat_result,
171:                  (unsigned long)g_heartbeat_reported);
172:         }
173:     }
174: 
175:   if (g_heartbeat_result < 0)
176:     {
177:       g_heartbeat_failures++;
178:       if ((g_heartbeat_failures & (g_heartbeat_failures - 1u)) == 0)
179:         {
180:           syslog(LOG_ERR, "IPC heartbeat failed: %d count=%lu\n",
181:                  g_heartbeat_result,
182:                  (unsigned long)g_heartbeat_failures);
183:         }
184: 
185:       g_heartbeat_result = OK;
186:     }
187: 
188:   now = clock_systime_ticks();
189:   if ((sclock_t)(now - g_next_heartbeat) < 0)
190:     {
191:       return;
192:     }
193: 
194:   *payload = 0;
195:   __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
196:   memset(&message, 0, sizeof(message));
197:   message.header = IPC_CPU1_HEART_BEAT_INDICATION;
198:   message.payload_address = BK7258_IPC_TX_ADDRESS;
199:   message.payload_length = sizeof(*payload);
200:   g_heartbeat_result = -EINPROGRESS;
201:   g_heartbeat_pending = true;
202:   ret = bk7258_mailbox_send_wire(BK7258_MB_CHAN_HW_CTRL_TX, &message,
203:                                  ipc_heartbeat_complete, NULL);
204:   if (ret == OK)
205:     {
206:       g_heartbeat_submissions++;
207:       g_next_heartbeat = now + IPC_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL;
208:       if (g_heartbeat_submissions <= 3u)
209:         {
210:           printf("IPC: heartbeat queued count=%lu tick=%llu\n",
211:                  (unsigned long)g_heartbeat_submissions,
212:                  (unsigned long long)now);
213:         }
214:     }
215:   else
216:     {
217:       g_heartbeat_pending = false;
218:       g_heartbeat_result = ret;
219:       g_next_heartbeat = now + IPC_HEARTBEAT_RETRY;
220:     }
221: }

223: int bk7258_ipc_heartbeat_start(void)
224: {
225:   int pid;
226:   int ret;
227: 
228:   if (g_ipc_started)
229:     {
230:       return g_ipc_start_result;
231:     }
232: 
233:   g_ipc_start_result = -EINPROGRESS;
234:   g_heartbeat_enabled = false;
235:   g_heartbeat_pending = false;
236:   g_heartbeat_completions = 0;
237:   g_heartbeat_failures = 0;
238:   g_heartbeat_submissions = 0;

266:              "now=%llu deadline=%llu\n",

539:             {
540:               return -ENOLINK;
541:             }
542:         }
543:       else if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY)
544:         {
545:           active = &g_active;
546:           if (active->quarantine)
547:             {
548:               return -ENOLINK;
549:             }
550:         }
551:       else
552:         {
553:           return OK;
554:         }
555: 
556:       if (!epoch->replay || active != &epoch->probe)
557:         {
558:           memset(&active->message, 0, sizeof(active->message));
559:           memcpy(&active->message, &channel->pending,
560:                  sizeof(active->message));
561:           active->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
562:             bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending),
563:             bk7258_mb_header_state(&channel->pending), 0, ++g_tx_seq,
564:             g_channel_ids[i]);
565:         }
566: 
567:       active->callback = channel->callback;
568:       active->arg = channel->arg;
569:       active->channel_index = i;
570:       active->started = clock_systime_ticks();
571:       active->busy = true;
572:       ret = send_slot(&active->message, &active->order);
573:       if (ret < 0)
574:         {
575:           active->busy = false;
576:           return ret;
577:         }
578: 
579:       if (active == &epoch->probe)
580:         {
581:           if (epoch->first_probe_order == 0)
582:             {
583:               epoch->first_probe_order = active->order;
584:             }
585: 
586:           g_probe_attempts++;
587:           g_stats.probes++;
588:         }
589: 
590:       return OK;
591:     }
592: 
593:   return OK;
594: }

596: static uint32_t ack_header_reason(
597:   const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
598:   const struct active_transaction *active)
599: {
600:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
601:   uint32_t reason = 0;
602: 
603:   if (!active->busy)
604:     {
605:       return 1u;
606:     }
607: 
608:   if (control != BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX)
609:     {
610:       reason |= 2u;
611:     }
612:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) !=
613:       bk7258_mb_header_channel(&active->message))
614:     {
615:       reason |= 4u;
616:     }
617:   if (bk7258_mb_header_seq(message) !=
618:       bk7258_mb_header_seq(&active->message))
619:     {
620:       reason |= 8u;
621:     }
622:   if (bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) !=
623:       bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&active->message))
624:     {
625:       reason |= 16u;
626:     }
627: 
628:   return reason;
629: }

631: static bool valid_uart_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
632: {
633:   return (message->payload_address & ~3u) == 0 &&
634:          message->payload_length == 0 && message->flags == 0 &&
635:          message->crc8 == 0 && message->reserved == 0;
636: }
637: 
638: static void handle_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
639: {
640:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = current_recovery();
641:   struct active_transaction *active;
642:   bool replay;
643:   int result;
644:   uint32_t reason;
645: 
646: 
647:   active = busy_probe();
648:   if (active == NULL)
649:     {
650:       active = &g_active;
651:     }
652: 
653:   g_stats.last_ack_header = message->header;
654:   g_stats.last_active_header = active->message.header;
655:   reason = ack_header_reason(message, active);
656:   if (reason != 0)
657:     {
658:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
659:       g_stats.bad_ack_reason |= reason;
660:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(0, g_stats.last_ack_header);
661:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(1, g_stats.last_active_header);
662:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(2, g_stats.bad_ack_reason);
663:       return;
664:     }
665: 
666: 
667:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
668:       !valid_uart_ack(message))
669:     {
670:       /* Keep active stable.  A malformed ACK is not an ownership proof. */
671: 
672:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
673:       g_stats.bad_ack_reason |= 32u;
674:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(2, g_stats.bad_ack_reason);
675:       return;
676:     }
677: 
678:   if ((bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & ~BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0)
679:     {
680:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
681:       g_stats.bad_ack_reason |= 64u;
682:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(2, g_stats.bad_ack_reason);
683:       return;
684:     }
685: 
686:   result = (bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0 ?
687:            -EREMOTEIO : OK;
688: 
689:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
690:       result == OK && (message->payload_address & 2u) != 0)
691:     {
692:       result = -EREMOTEIO;
693:     }
694: 
695:   replay = active == &epoch->probe && epoch->replay;
696:   release_acks_before(replay ? epoch->first_probe_order : active->order);
697:   if (replay)
698:     {
699:       unsigned int replay_index = g_recovery_index;
700:       unsigned int i;
701: 
702:       /* This ACK may be a late ACK for the original copy.  It proves every
703:        * older epoch was copied, but not that the new replay envelope was
704:        * copied.  Preserve the replay epoch, free only older epochs, and use
705:        * one of them for a fresh-sequence confirmation probe.
706:        */
707: 
708:       complete_transaction(active, message, -EAGAIN);
709:       g_active.quarantine = false;
710:       for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
711:         {
712:           if (i != replay_index)
713:             {
714:               memset(&g_recovery[i], 0, sizeof(g_recovery[i]));
715:             }
716:         }
717: 
718:       select_recovery_epoch();
719:       (void)dispatch_locked();
720:       return;
721:     }
722: 
723:   complete_transaction(active, message, result);
724: 
725:   if (active == &epoch->probe)
726:     {
727:       if (result == OK && (message->flags & 2u) == 0)
728:         {
729:           release_recovery_slots();
730:           g_recovery_index = 0;
731:           g_probe_attempts = 0;
732:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_READY);
733:         }
734:       else if (result == -EREMOTEIO &&
735:                g_probe_attempts < MB_PROBE_MAX_ATTEMPTS)
736:         {
737:           /* CP may not have opened MB_UART0 yet.  The matched ACK proves
738:            * that this probe slot is no longer referenced by its FIFO.
739:            */
740:         }
741:       else
742:         {
743:           g_stats.probe_fail++;
744:           epoch->probe.quarantine = result == -ETIMEDOUT;
745:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN);
746:         }
747:     }
748: 
749:   else if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
750:            result < 0)
751:     {
752:       begin_abort(result);
753:     }
754: 
755:   (void)dispatch_locked();
756: }
757: 
758: static int handle_command(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
759: {
760:   struct ack_slot *slot;
761:   unsigned int rx_index;
762:   uint8_t channel = bk7258_mb_header_channel(message);
763:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
764:   uint8_t ack_flags = 0;
765:   uint8_t state = 0;
766:   int ret = -ENOSYS;
767: 
768:   g_stats.last_command_header = message->header;
769: 
770:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) == 0)
771:     {
772:       slot = alloc_ack_slot();
773:       if (slot == NULL)
774:         {
775:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
776:           return -EAGAIN;
777:         }
778:     }
779:   else
780:     {
781:       slot = NULL;
782:     }
783: 
784:   if ((control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0 ||
785:       bk7258_mb_header_state(message) != 0 ||
786:       (channel & 0xf0u) != 0x40u)
787:     {
788:       g_stats.bad_header++;
789:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
790:     }
791:   else if ((rx_index = rx_channel_index(channel)) < MB_RX_CHANNEL_COUNT &&
792:            g_rx_callbacks[rx_index] != NULL)
793:     {
794:       ret = g_rx_callbacks[rx_index](message, &ack_flags,
795:                                       g_rx_args[rx_index]);
796:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
797:         {
798:           if (slot != NULL)
799:             {
800:               slot->state = ACK_SLOT_FREE;
801:             }
802: 
803:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
804:           return -EAGAIN;
805:         }
806:       else if (ret < 0)
807:         {
808:           state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
809:         }
810:     }
811:   else if (channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_PWC_RX && g_pwc_rx != NULL)
812:     {
813:       ret = g_pwc_rx(message);
814:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
815:         {
816:           if (slot != NULL)
817:             {
818:               slot->state = ACK_SLOT_FREE;
819:             }
820: 
821:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
822:           return -EAGAIN;
823:         }
824:       else if (ret < 0)
825:         {
826:           state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
827:         }
828:     }
829:   else if (channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_SARADC_RX &&
830:            (bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) == 0u ||
831:             bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) == 1u) &&
832:            message->payload_address == 1u &&
833:            message->payload_length == 0u && message->flags == 0u &&
834:            message->crc8 == 0u && message->reserved == 0u)
835:     {
836:       /* Match Armino's SARADC operation-notification ABI. */
837:       ack_flags = 2u;
838:       ret = OK;
839:     }
840:   else
841:     {
842:       g_stats.unsupported++;
843:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
844:     }
845: 
846:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) != 0)
847:     {
848:       return OK;
849:     }
850: 
851:   memset(&slot->message, 0, sizeof(slot->message));
852:   slot->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
853:     bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message), state, BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX,
854:     bk7258_mb_header_seq(message), channel);
855:   slot->message.payload_address = ack_flags;
856: 
857:   if (ack_slots_used() >= MB_ACK_HIGH_WATER)
858:     {
859:       g_probe_requested = true;
860:     }
861: 
862:   (void)dispatch_locked();
863:   return OK;
864: }
865: 
866: static int mailbox_rx(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
867: {
868:   irqstate_t flags;
869:   uint8_t control;
870: 
871:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
872:   g_stats.rx++;
873:   control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
874: 
875:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET) != 0)
876:     {
877:       if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX) == 0 ||
878:           (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) & 0xf0u) != 0x40u ||
879:           (control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0)
880:         {
881:           g_stats.bad_header++;
882:         }
883:       else
884:         {
885:           g_stats.resets++;
886:           g_peer_reset_generation++;
887:           bk7258_mbox_discard_deferred();
888:           begin_abort(-ECONNRESET);
889:         }
890:     }
891:   else if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX) != 0)
892:     {
893:       handle_ack(message);
894:     }
895:   else
896:     {
897:       int ret = handle_command(message);
898: 
899:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
900:         {
901:           rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
902:           return ret;
903:         }
904:     }
905: 
906:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
907:   nxsem_post(&g_tx_sem);
908:   return OK;
909: }

911: static int mailbox_diag_worker(int argc, char **argv)
912: {
913:   enum bk7258_mb_link_state reported = BK7258_MB_LINK_QUIESCING;
914:   int ret;
915: 
916:   (void)argc;
917:   (void)argv;
918:   ret = bind_worker_to_primary();
919:   if (ret < 0)
920:     {
921:       return -EXDEV;
922:     }
923: 
924:   for (;;)
925:     {
926:       nxsem_wait_uninterruptible(&g_diag_sem);
927:       irqstate_t flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
928:       enum bk7258_mb_link_state state = g_diag_state;
929:       bk7258_mb_link_callback_t callback = g_link_callback;
930:       void *callback_arg = g_link_arg;
931:       uint32_t timeout = g_stats.timeout;
932:       uint32_t bad_ack = g_stats.bad_ack;
933:       uint8_t epoch = g_recovery_index;
934: 
935:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
936:       if (reported == state)
937:         {
938:           continue;
939:         }
940: 
941:       reported = state;
942:       if (reported != BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING &&
943:           reported != BK7258_MB_LINK_READY)
944:         {
945:           syslog(LOG_WARNING,
946:                  "mailbox: link state=%u epoch=%u timeout=%lu bad_ack=%lu\n",
947:                  reported, epoch, (unsigned long)timeout,
948:                  (unsigned long)bad_ack);
949:         }
950: 
951:       if (callback != NULL)
952:         {
953:           callback(reported, callback_arg);
954:         }
955:     }
956: 
957:   return OK;
958: }
