960: static int mailbox_tx_worker(int argc, char **argv)
961: {
962:   int ret;
963: 
964:   (void)argc;
965:   (void)argv;
966:   ret = bind_worker_to_primary();
967:   if (ret < 0)
968:     {
969:       ret = -EXDEV;
970:     }
971: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
972:   else if (!bk7258_smp_secondary_is_ready())
973:     {
974:       ret = -EAGAIN;
975:     }
976: #endif
977:   if (ret < 0)
978:     {
979:       return ret;
980:     }
981: 
982:   for (;;)
983:     {
984:       struct active_transaction *probe;
985:       irqstate_t flags;
986:       bool request_probe;
987: 
988:       (void)nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_tx_sem, MB_WORK_INTERVAL);
989:       flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
990: 
991:       probe = busy_probe();
992:       if ((g_active.busy &&
993:            clock_systime_ticks() - g_active.started >= MB_TIMEOUT) ||
994:           (probe != NULL &&
995:            clock_systime_ticks() - probe->started >= MB_TIMEOUT))
996:         {
997:           g_stats.timeout++;
998:           bk7258_boottrace_detail(3,
999:             (g_stats.last_tx_error & 0xffu) |
1000:             ((g_stats.timeout & 0xffu) << 8) |
1001:             ((g_stats.fifo_full & 0xffu) << 16) |
1002:             ((g_stats.ack_overflow & 0xffu) << 24));
1003:           if (probe != NULL)
1004:             {
1005:               probe->quarantine = true;
1006:               complete_transaction(probe, NULL, -ETIMEDOUT);
1007:               g_stats.probe_fail++;
1008:               set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN);
1009:             }
1010:           else
1011:             {
1012:               begin_abort(-ETIMEDOUT);
1013:             }
1014:         }
1015: 
1016:       if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN &&
1017:           clock_systime_ticks() - g_down_since >= MB_DOWN_RETRY)
1018:         {
1019:           select_recovery_epoch();
1020:         }
1021: 
1022:       (void)dispatch_locked();
1023:       if (g_probe_requested && ack_slots_used() < MB_ACK_HIGH_WATER)
1024:         {
1025:           g_probe_requested = false;
1026:         }
1027: 
1028:       request_probe = g_probe_requested &&
1029:                       g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY &&
1030:                       !g_channels[4].queued && !g_active.busy;
1031:       if (request_probe)
1032:         {
1033:           g_probe_requested = false;
1034:         }
1035: 
1036:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1037: 
1038:       if (request_probe)
1039:         {
1040:           bk7258_mb_uart_request_state();
1041:         }
1042:     }
1043: 
1044:   return OK;
1045: }

1075: int bk7258_mailbox_workers_start(void)
1076: {
1077:   cpu_set_t cpuset;
1078:   int ret;
1079: 
1080:   if (!g_initialized)
1081:     {
1082:       return -EAGAIN;
1083:     }
1084: 
1085:   if (g_workers_started)
1086:     {
1087:       return OK;
1088:     }
1089: 
1090:   ret = wait_secondary_scheduler();
1091:   if (ret < 0)
1092:     {
1093:       return ret;
1094:     }
1095: 
1096: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
1097:   /* All physical CP descriptors must originate on logical CPU0.  Pin the
1098:    * creator before activating the workers so their inherited affinity is
1099:    * CPU0-only from their first scheduled instruction. */
1100: 
1101:   CPU_ZERO(&cpuset);
1102:   CPU_SET(0, &cpuset);
1103:   ret = sched_setaffinity(0, sizeof(cpuset), &cpuset);
1104:   if (ret < 0)
1105:     {
1106:       return ret;
1107:     }
1108: #endif
1109: 
1110:   ret = bk7258_timer_start();
1111:   if (ret < 0)
1112:     {
1113:       return ret;
1114:     }
1115: 
1116:   bk7258_boottrace_primary(BK7258_BOOT_TIMER_RETURN);
1117: 
1118:   if (!g_tx_worker_created)
1119:     {
1120:       ret = kthread_create("mbox-v2", MB_TX_BOOT_PRIORITY, 2048,
1121:                            mailbox_tx_worker, NULL);
1122:       if (ret < 0)
1123:         {
1124:           return ret;
1125:         }
1126: 
1127:       g_tx_worker_created = true;
1128:       g_tx_worker_pid = ret;
1129:     }
1130: 
1131:   if (!g_diag_worker_created)
1132:     {
1133:       ret = kthread_create("mbox-diag", 80, 1024, mailbox_diag_worker, NULL);
1134:       if (ret < 0)
1135:         {
1136:           return ret;
1137:         }
1138: 
1139:       g_diag_worker_created = true;
1140:     }
1141: 
1142:   g_workers_started = true;
1143:   bk7258_boottrace_primary(BK7258_BOOT_TIMER_READY);
1144:   return OK;
1145: }

1184: int bk7258_mailbox_send_wire(uint8_t logical_channel,
1185:                              const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
1186:                              bk7258_mb_tx_complete_t callback, void *arg)
1187: {
1188:   struct logical_channel *channel;
1189:   unsigned int index;
1190:   irqstate_t flags;
1191: 
1192:   if (!g_initialized || !g_physical_started || message == NULL)
1193:     {
1194:       return -EAGAIN;
1195:     }
1196: 
1197:   index = channel_index(logical_channel);
1198:   if (index >= MB_CHANNEL_COUNT)
1199:     {
1200:       return -EINVAL;
1201:     }
1202: 
1203:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
1204:   channel = &g_channels[index];
1205: 
1206:   if (channel->queued)
1207:     {
1208:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1209:       return -EBUSY;
1210:     }
1211: 
1212:   if (g_link_state != BK7258_MB_LINK_READY &&
1213:       !(g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING &&
1214:         logical_channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
1215:         bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) == BK7258_MB_UART_STATE))
1216:     {
1217:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1218:       return -ENOLINK;
1219:     }
1220: 
1221:   if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY && g_active.quarantine)
1222:     {
1223:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1224:       return -ENOLINK;
1225:     }
1226: 
1227:   memset(&channel->pending, 0, sizeof(channel->pending));
1228:   memcpy(&channel->pending, message, sizeof(channel->pending));
1229:   channel->callback = callback;
1230:   channel->arg = arg;
1231:   channel->result = -EINPROGRESS;
1232:   channel->queued = true;
1233: 
1234:   if (up_cpu_index() == 0)
1235:     {
1236:       (void)dispatch_locked();
1237:     }
1238: 
1239:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1240: 
1241:   /* CPU1 callers only enqueue work.  Physical descriptors to the CP still
1242:    * originate exclusively from logical CPU0.
1243:    */
1244: 
1245:   nxsem_post(&g_tx_sem);
1246:   return OK;

1420: {
1421:   unsigned int index = channel_index(logical_channel);
1422:   clock_t deadline = clock_systime_ticks() + MSEC2TICK(timeout_ms);

1427:     }

1429:   for (;;)
1430:     {

1436:       queued = g_channels[index].queued;
1437:       result = g_channels[index].result;
1438:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1439:       if (!queued)
1440:         {

211:                            MB_UART_TX_SIZE;

214:           g_uart.stats.resets++;
215:         }

218:           g_uart.stats.remote_fail++;
219:           g_uart.state_pending = true;

224:                */

627: ssize_t bk7258_mbox_uart_write(const uint8_t *data, size_t length)
628: {
629:   irqstate_t flags;
630:   uint16_t available;
631:   uint16_t written;
632:   uint16_t first;
633: 
634:   if (data == NULL && length != 0)
635:     {
636:       return -EINVAL;
637:     }
638: 
639:   if (length == 0)
640:     {
641:       return 0;
642:     }
643: 
644:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
645:   available = tx_free();
646:   written = length > available ? available : length;
647:   first = MB_UART_TX_SIZE - g_uart.tx_write;
648:   if (first > written)
649:     {
650:       first = written;
651:     }
652: 
653:   memcpy(&g_uart.tx_ring[g_uart.tx_write], data, first);
654:   if (first != written)
655:     {
656:       memcpy(g_uart.tx_ring, data + first, written - first);
657:     }
658: 
659:   g_uart.tx_write = (g_uart.tx_write + written) % MB_UART_TX_SIZE;
660:   g_uart.stats.write_calls++;
661:   g_uart.stats.write_bytes += written;
662:   if (written < length)
663:     {
664:       g_uart.stats.short_writes++;
665:     }
666: 
667:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
668:   if (g_uart.initialized && written != 0)
669:     {
670:       nxsem_post(&g_uart.worker_sem);
671:     }
672: 
673:   return written;
674: }

676: ssize_t bk7258_mbox_uart_read(uint8_t *data, size_t length,
677:                               unsigned int *status)
678: {
679:   irqstate_t flags;
680:   uint16_t available;
681:   uint16_t count;
682:   uint16_t first;
683: 
684:   if (data == NULL || length == 0)
685:     {
686:       return -EINVAL;
687:     }
688: 
689:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
690:   available = rx_count();
691:   count = length > available ? available : length;
692:   first = MB_UART_RX_SIZE - g_uart.rx_read;
693:   if (first > count)
694:     {
695:       first = count;
696:     }
697: 
698:   memcpy(data, &g_uart.rx_ring[g_uart.rx_read], first);
699:   if (first != count)
700:     {
701:       memcpy(data + first, g_uart.rx_ring, count - first);
702:     }
703: 
704:   g_uart.rx_read = (g_uart.rx_read + count) % MB_UART_RX_SIZE;
705:   if (status != NULL)
706:     {
707:       *status = g_uart.sticky_status;
708:       g_uart.sticky_status = 0;
709:     }
710: 
711:   if (!g_uart.upper_rts && g_uart.local_rts &&
712:       rx_count() < MB_UART_RTS_RELEASE)
713:     {
714:       update_local_rts();
715:     }
716: 
717:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
718:   if (g_uart.initialized && count != 0)
719:     {
720:       nxsem_post(&g_uart.worker_sem);
721:     }
722: 
723:   return count;
724: }

775: int bk7258_mbox_uart_flush(unsigned int timeout_ms)
776: {
